reviewItem.question: For "Line removed from cmd/crossplane/core/core.go: log.Info(\"Composition Functions are GA and cannot be disabled. The --enable-composition-functions flag will be…", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

proposed.statement: In v2.0.0, Crossplane core no longer logs "Composition Functions are GA and cannot be disabled. The --enable-composition-functions flag will be removed in a future release." What this means for the --enable-composition-functions flag is not stated.
